name: Nathan Henkes
occupation: Campbell County attorney (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Campbell County attorney (won the November 2022 general election)
background: Nathan Henkes is the Campbell County attorney, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The county's official attorney page lists him in that office. County 17 reported in April 2026 that he was not running for re-election. Incoming attorney Kyle Ferris takes office in January 2027.
